meta_title: All features: store, delivery, confirmation and stock
meta_description: Online store, AI landing pages, 26 delivery companies, confirmation companies, stock, in-shop sales and net profit. Every MdStore feature on one page.
title: Everything you need to sell,
subtitle: From the first visit to your store to the parcel arriving and your net profit. These are all of MdStore's features, grouped by your daily work.

stats.label: communes ready in the order form

groups.title: A store ready in minutes
groups.desc: A store with your name, logo and colours, with no technical skills.
items: Ready themes for every niche: beauty, clothing, shoes, electronics, food and more
A theme of your own, designed by AI from your description
Three languages: Arabic, French, English
One hero image for desktop and a different one for phones
Free delivery above an amount you set
A free link straight away, or connect your own domain
The domain shows the whole store, a landing page or a single product
Several stores in one account, with combined statistics

groups.title: Products with every detail
groups.desc: Show your product the way you really sell it, with its options and offers.
items: Sizes and colours, each with its own price, stock and image
Quantity offers: buy more, pay less
Optional add-ons with the product
The old price crossed out next to the new one
Digital products with no delivery
An "Ask on WhatsApp" button on each product
Barcodes and label printing
Import a product from AliExpress with one link
Statistics per product: views, orders, conversion rate

groups.title: Landing pages that sell
groups.desc: A page for every product and every campaign, ready in minutes.
items: Drag-and-drop editor, no code at all
A full page written by AI from the product description
Product images and page sections made by AI
A/B test: one link splits visitors across two or three pages and shows the winner
Its own domain and pixel for each page
Duplicate, publish or unpublish a page in one click

groups.title: Your orders under control
groups.desc: Every order in its place, from the first call to delivery.
items: Clear statuses: pending, call attempts, confirmed, in delivery, delivered, returned
Notes with ready reasons: no answer, phone off, changed their mind
Create an order by hand and edit it
The source of every order: Facebook, TikTok, Google
Abandoned orders: the customer typed a number and did not finish, so you can call them
Excel export
Sync with Google Sheets, and change the status from the sheet itself

groups.title: Protection from fake and duplicate orders
groups.desc: Know your customer before you send the parcel.
items: A colour and an alert on every order show the customer's history: new, trusted, returns often, duplicate
Works across all your stores together, not just one
Recognises the same number even when it is written differently
A duplicate order stays with you and is not sent to confirmation automatically
A list of the numbers of customers who return often
The wilayas with the most returns, so you can decide where to sell

groups.title: Confirmation companies
groups.desc: Let a professional team call your customers.
items: A directory of confirmation companies, searchable by name and wilaya
Send orders by hand or automatically
Preferred agents who take your orders first
You choose what is not sent automatically: duplicates, customers who return often
Take an order back from the company at any time
A full log for every order: who called and when

groups.title: 26 delivery companies
groups.desc: Send your orders and track them without leaving the dashboard.
items: Yalidine, ZR Express, Maystro Delivery, Yalitec and 22 other companies
Send orders to the company in bulk
Automatic tracking: the parcel status updates by itself
Print shipping labels in bulk
Scan the barcode when handing parcels to the courier and on return
An alert to call the customer before the parcel comes back
Prices per wilaya, for home and office, imported from the delivery company
Switch off a wilaya or specific communes

groups.title: Stock and in-shop sales
groups.desc: One stock for your online store and your shop.
items: Stock goes down on confirmation and comes back on cancellation or return
An alert when stock is running low
Stock value and expected profit
A log of every movement: who, why and which order
Sell in your shop from the phone: scan the barcode with the camera and print a receipt
Sell on credit with partial payments
Sell services: phone top-ups, bills, repairs
A list of customers, their orders and their debts

groups.title: Your real profit
groups.desc: Not the sales figure, but what stays in your pocket.
items: Net profit after ads, purchase cost, delivery, returns and confirmation fees
Ad cost per order
A warning when the ad costs more than the product's margin
Return rate
Revenue today and this month, compared with last week
Best products and best wilayas

groups.title: Pixels and search engines
groups.desc: Your ads know who really bought.
items: Facebook, TikTok and Google Analytics with no code
Conversions API: the event arrives even with ad blockers
A "Purchase" event when the order is confirmed, not only when the form is filled
Pixels on three levels: store, page, product
Google title and description, and the share image
Google Search Console and Bing verification

groups.title: Team and wallet
groups.desc: Share the work and stay informed about everything.
items: Invite a member by email or phone number
Detailed permissions: who sees orders, who edits products, who sells in the shop
An activity log of everything the team did
Top up the wallet by card: CIB and Edahabia
Top up with Binance Pay and USDT
Automatic subscription renewal from the wallet

groups.title: App and integrations
groups.desc: Your store in your pocket, connected to your tools.
items: A phone app installed from the browser, on iPhone and Android
An instant phone notification for every new order
Manage the store by conversation from Claude and ChatGPT
API keys for developers
A media library with automatic compression and a crop tool
An inbox for customer messages from the "Contact us" form
